correctness.rationale: Over nonmodular F_q and odd A, finite Fourier inversion turns idempotence under e_xe_y=e_(2y-x) into f(chi)=f(chi^-1) f(chi^2). On each active H_m=<2,-1> orbit, f(chi^-1)=f(chi)^-1 and f(chi^2)=f(chi)^2, forcing E_m-th roots. Frobenius f(chi^q)=f(chi)^q merges H_m to L_m=<2,-1,q> orbits and restricts each seed to g_m=gcd(E_m,|q^t-b|) values. Exact-order-m character count by Mobius inversion N_m=sum_{h|m}mu(m/h) prod_i gcd(h,n_i) supplies N_m/|L_m| orbits and bivariate factor (1+Y)prod_{m>1}(1+g_m X^{|L_m|})^{N_m/|L_m|}. All fields nonmodular, odd finite abelian A, with no splitting assumption. Independently checked all 512 F_2[C3xC3] coefficients directly and obtained the full nontrivial Fourier-support/augmentation distribution (1+Y)(1+3X^2)^4 with 512 total; C11 F2/F3 examples appear in prior published cyclic formula and are not new.
